app.name: WiiCam test
app.short_description: Test build for WiiCam issues #1, #3 and #4
app.long_description:
A test build for WiiCam. It installs as its own app and doesn't replace WiiCam.
Issue #1: cameras with more than 2,048 bytes of USB descriptors, like the Logitech C920, can now be listed. With such a camera, start this app, then unplug the camera and plug it back in, then press A.
Issues #2 and #3: videos from cameras that leave the Huffman tables out of their frames now carry them, so the Photo Channel can play the videos.
Issue #4: microphones that only record in stereo, or at 32 or 48 kHz, can now record sound. The C920's microphone is one of them.
Please share SD:/wc04-camera/session.log on the issue, and any video that doesn't play. Everything else works like WiiCam 1.0.0-beta.
